verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant work directly inside the workspace within user-set limits. Users can ask questions in natural language, such as "What evidence requests are still outstanding on this audit?", and the assistant can list audits and evidence requests and add comments, attachments, and status updates. The in-app AI Helpbot (cmd/ctrl+K) only answers support and documentation questions, so natural-language operation depends on an external assistant connected through MCP. Missing for 10: natural-language control over most of the product (controls, policies, risks, access reviews, monitors); a native in-app natural-language command interface; independent or hands-on corroboration.
